title: 人生字场旅程｜手写触发、空间短词与眼神收束
source_title: 选择之路｜成年人物把手写句子推进为城市字场
summary: 先用成年人物的一次书写动作提出主题，再让原创短词依次变成圆环、道路、台阶和环境标记；人物持续穿过这些文字结构，终局回到同一身份的眼神或静止主标。
input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject, three identity anchors and one continuous world axis. + Bind each decisive action to exactly one short original semantic word that appears only after the action begins. + Make each word occupy, divide, reflect or redirect the physical environment rather than float as a subtitle. + Escalate typography scale and spatial depth while preserving identity, travel direction and readable action. + Return to the same adult face or full-body anchor and resolve the word sequence into one terminal identity proof.
recommended_input: 锁定原创成年城市规划师：黑色短发、锈红外套、黄铜笔记本，位于蓝调时刻的安静车站。；她穿过通道，准确短词【CROSS】变成通往远端站台的琥珀色地面横条。；以稳定眼神收束，全部结构折叠成可读原创句【MAKE THE NEXT MAP】并同时静止。
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity and one initial writing action establish authorship of the word system.
Each new exact short word follows one visible action and becomes one distinct environmental structure.
Previous words remain traceable as later chapters increase scale or density.
The final close view recombines all semantic stages into one exact original sentence and a stable personal reaction.
